newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexicana says completes financial restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Mexicana says completes financial restructuring.

text.p: Mexican carrier Mexicana, a unit of airline holding company Cintra, said on Wednesday it had completed its financial restructuring by paying $33.5 million in short-term debt.
It paid 168.3 million pesos to Mexico's Finance Ministry, 17.3 million pesos to Mexico's National Social Security Institute (IMSS) and $8.9 million to export bank Bancomext.

"With these payments, which amount to $33.5 million, Mexicana de Aviacion completes its financial restructuring by having paid its debts, negotiated at the beginning of the year, for maturities of two and four years," it said in a statement.
